description:
Write and execute a Gretl hansl script to perform Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV) for the model 'food_exp = const + income' using the loaded 'food.gdt' dataset (40 observations).

Your script must:
1. Loop through all 40 observations.
2. For each iteration, estimate the model excluding the current observation (training size = 39).
3. Predict the food_exp value for the excluded observation.
4. Compute the Mean Squared Prediction Error (MSPE) and Root Mean Squared Prediction Error (RMSPE) based on the 40 out-of-sample errors.
5. Save a summary file to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/cv_results.txt' containing the text 'MSPE: <value>' and 'RMSPE: <value>'.
6. Save the individual predictions to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/cv_predictions.csv' with 40 rows, including the actual 'food_exp' and the predicted value.

Note: You can use the Gretl script editor (File > Script files > New script) to write and run the code.
